business_scope.primary_industry_name: Commercial Shipbuilding of Deep-Sea Dry Cargo and Container Vessels

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Common Law and French Civil Law, with customary law overlay)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: No comprehensive bilateral investment treaty or double taxation agreement in force
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER) Plus trade agreement membership
Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs) with Australia, New Zealand, Japan, Faroe Islands, and Greenland

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap. 222], as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2014 and 2019; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 41 of 2006, as amended 2016 and 2021; Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act No. 34 of 2021; United Nations (Financial Prohibitions, Arms Embargoes and Sanctions) Act 2009

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of beneficial owner's passport (biometric page)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in beneficial owner's country of residence; consular officer where additional authentication is required
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization by the Republic of Vanuatu High Commission or Consulate (Vanuatu is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original Bank Reference Letter confirming account standing and signatory authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed bank or financial institution of the applicant or beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization followed by Consular Legalization through the Vanuatu High Commission or Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Certificate of Good Standing / Police Clearance Certificate for each natural person UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent police authority or criminal records bureau of the beneficial owner's jurisdiction of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization; apostille acceptable only if the originating jurisdiction is a Hague Apostille member and Vanuatu expressly accepts it on a case-by-case basis

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate Charter, Constitution, and Trade/Commercial Registry Extract (when a UBO is a legal entity)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country companies registry or equivalent corporate registrar
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization or apostille issued by the home-country competent authority

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Due Diligence Questionnaire and Source of Wealth Declaration
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Applicant through the VFSC-licensed registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certified by the registered agent; no external consular legalization required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, signatories, and counterparties against the OFAC SDN List, UN Consolidated List of targeted financial sanctions, UK HMT/OFSI sanctions list, EU consolidated financial sanctions list, and the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU) domestic watchlist. Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) require enhanced due diligence, a two-year post-office cooling-off period, and senior management approval. Ongoing transaction and counterparty screening is required under the AML/CTF Act, with risk-rating performed at onboarding and at least annually. Records must be retained for a minimum of five years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Online Registry (I-Business / Company Registrar ePortal)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Proposed names must be submitted in Latin-script characters (A-Z, numerals 0-9, and limited permitted symbols). The corporate name must end with one of the statutory designators: 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Corp', 'Incorporated', 'Inc', or approved French equivalents. Transliteration into local Bislama or French is not mandatory; however, English and French names must be transliterated consistently. Names containing Bislama words must be accompanied by an English translation. The selected name must be distinguishable from all existing names on the Vanuatu companies register.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant may request written reasons from the VFSC Companies Registry within 10 business days. A formal appeal must be lodged with the VFSC Registrar within 21 days of receiving the rejection decision, using Form Name-Claim-1 and attaching a fresh name search report, the written rejection notice, and payment of the USD 200 appeal fee. The Registrar must issue a decision within 15 working days. No further administrative appeal is available; however, the applicant may file a completely new name application after 30 days from the final rejection. If the name is reserved and usage lapses after the validity window, the applicant may request a one-time renewal of 15 days for an additional fee, subject to registry discretion.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted as the sole registered office for a Vanuatu International Company. A physical registered office must be maintained in Vanuatu through a VFSC-licensed registered agent. A virtual mailbox outside Vanuatu may be used for correspondence but cannot satisfy the statutory registered-office requirement. For an ISIC 3011 commercial shipyard operation, additional local commercial substance (e.g., an operational office, lease agreement, or physical yard) will likely be required to support the vessel construction activity, although a pure non-resident shipbuilder may operate on a tax-exempt basis without an active physical presence.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate (approximately 25% over the first three years) for a high-value entity classified as 'Commercial Shipyard Manufacturing'. Unannounced on-site inspections are infrequent but possible under the VFSC's risk-based AML/CFT supervision, with priority assigned on the basis of transaction size, cross-border trade flows, PEP exposure, and exemption from local taxation.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act No. 32 of 1992 [Cap. 222], as amended; sections 7-13 (incorporation, memorandum, and articles); sections 14-17 (registered office and registered agent); sections 24-29 (directors, officers, and their powers).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificate of Incorporation (International Company) issued on Form IC-1 together with the filed Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; shares may be issued with or without par value and for cash or non-cash consideration as determined by directors. No capital escrow is mandated for incorporation; however, the shipyard's commercial payment rails require escrow accounts for maritime installments and letter of credit funded construction contracts as a contractual, not licensing, condition.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED BY THE SUBSCRIBERS AND DIRECTORS AS A FIRST WRITTEN RESOLUTION: THAT the subscribers shall be recorded as the initial shareholders of the Company. THAT the Memorandum and Articles of Association as filed with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission be adopted in full. THAT the registered office situated in Port Vila, Vanuatu be fixed and the licensed registered agent be appointed. THAT the following persons be appointed directors and officers, namely the Company Secretary and Chief Financial Officer, with powers to manage daily affairs. THAT the initial paid-up capital of US$1.00 per issued share be credited fully paid. THAT directors be authorized to open bank and escrow accounts, to execute shipyard operating license filings, environmental impact assessments, and workers' compensation coverage. THAT any director acting singly may attest to such instruments.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Clearance and Corporate Structure Pre-Screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Registry of International Companies, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage an approved VFSC registered agent to conduct a name availability search and pre-clearance submission. Ensure the proposed company name ends with '(International Company)' or 'IC Limited' and does not conflict with existing registered names. Simultaneously confirm that the ownership structure comprises non-resident shareholders and that the business scope expressly includes shipbuilding, vessel repair, slipway operation, and dry-dock services under ISIC 3011.
required_dossiers: Name reservation request form
Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Passport copies of beneficial owners and subscribers
Registered agent engagement letter
Corporate structure and ownership chart
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is refused for similarity or undesirability, reserve an alternate name and resubmit the pre-clearance with a revised constitutional draft within 3 business days at no additional assessment fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu notary public in conjunction with the VFSC-approved registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum of Association including an objects clause authorizing commercial shipbuilding of deep-sea dry cargo and container vessels, ship repair, and allied marine engineering. Draft the Articles of Association setting out share classes, director quorum, board powers, and indemnity provisions. Execute the constitutional documents before subscribers and obtain notarial certification of signatures.
required_dossiers: Memorandum of Association (3 original notarized copies)
Articles of Association (3 original notarized copies)
Notarized identification documents of each subscriber and director
Statement of proposed registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the VFSC queries the objects clause as too broad or imprecise for an International Company, file a supplemental alteration of the Memorandum conforming the objects to shipyard construction and vessel building only.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application and Payment of State Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Registry of International Companies, Port Vila (online portal and counter filing)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge the executed and notarized Memorandum and Articles, together with Form IC-1 and a statutory declaration of compliance, through the VFSC online filing system or the registered agent's counter. Pay the official state filing fee of USD 300 by wire transfer, bank cheque, or approved agent account. Retain the fee receipt as proof of lodgment.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Form IC-1 (Application for Incorporation of an International Company)
Statutory declaration of compliance signed by the registered agent
State filing fee remittance receipt
Consent of registered agent and registered office confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is rejected for incompleteness or defective notarization, cure the stated defects and re-file within 14 days; no new state fee is charged where the first filing bears a certified lodgment stamp.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory review, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation stating the company number, date of incorporation, and name. The International Company comes into legal existence on the date of the certificate. Verify the certificate details for exact name spelling, date, and registration number before retaining the original for subsequent licensing filings.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation (original)
Certified copies of the filed Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains an error in the corporate name or registration particulars, request a rectified certificate through a corrective filing with the VFSC Registrar, accompanied by the defective certificate and a written explanation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registered Office and Registered Agent Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-approved registered agent domiciled in Vanuatu
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the registered agent agreement and file the Notice of Registered Office with the VFSC using the agent's physical Port Vila address. The agent shall maintain the statutory registers of members, directors, and charges at the registered office and shall receive service of process on behalf of the company.
required_dossiers: Registered agent service agreement
Consent to act as registered agent
Notice of Registered Office form
Registered office address verification certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent resigns or is disqualified, the company has 21 days to appoint a replacement agent and file the change notice; failure to do so may lead to administrative strike-off, cured by reinstatement application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting, Statutory Registers, and Governance Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors acting under the Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or adopt a circular written resolution. Record the first board resolution adopting the share subscription, registered office, and officer appointments. Issue share certificates, open the register of members and directors, and file the beneficial ownership declaration with the registered agent in accordance with VFSC guidance.
required_dossiers: First board meeting minutes or written resolution
Share certificates in favor of initial subscribers
Register of members and register of directors
Beneficial ownership declaration
Minutes of officer appointment and signing authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a valid quorum cannot be achieved, circulate the resolution for signature by all directors in lieu of a meeting; any dissenting director's written objection shall be recorded and filed but does not invalidate the resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign Investment and Sectorial Pre-Licensing Application
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA), Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Foreign Investment Application referencing the Certificate of Incorporation and describing the proposed commercial shipyard project, including vessel tonnage capacity, slipway dimensions, capital injection, and employment plan for ni-Vanuatu workers. Obtain the Foreign Investment Licence as a precondition to land lease registration and industrial operating permits.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Foreign Investment Licence application form
Shipyard project description and site map
Business plan and capital injection proof
Evidence of availability of leasehold or freehold industrial land
Security clearance certificate from competent ministries (where applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Foreign Investment application is queried on sector eligibility or employment grounds, file a written objection and amended application with supporting evidence of local employment commitments; escalate to VIPA's internal review committee if the first response is adverse.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) in coordination with the Department of Industry, Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Commerce; for construction of vessels intended for Vanuatu flag registration, the Vanuatu Maritime Authority (VMA) class inspection approval is also mandatory
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Foreign Investment Licence — Shipyard Construction and Shipbuilding Operation Permit (ISIC 3011)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change and Natural Resources, Republic of Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category A — Full Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) Report required for commercial shipyard construction, dry-dock excavation, slipway installation, and related marine works exceeding minor development thresholds; a Preliminary Environmental Review may be accepted for co-located support buildings
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with the Environmental Protection and Conservation Act [Cap. 283]: wastewater discharges to marine waters must meet national receiving-water quality standards with oil-water separation before outfall; VOC emissions from painting and coating bays must be controlled through extraction and filtration equipment; hazardous wastes including antifouling residues, solvents, and scrap metal must be stored, labeled, and disposed under DEPC-approved waste management protocols; noise levels at the site boundary limited to industrial zoning thresholds with operational hours restrictions near residential areas.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification issued by the Vanuatu National Fire Service covering sprinkler systems, escape routes, and flammable material storage for shipyard paint and fuel depots; structural load inspection clearance issued by the Department of Public Works for slipway foundations, dry-dock gates, overhead cranes, and fabrication sheds; workplace health and safety clearance from the Department of Labour under the Employment Act [Cap. 160] including first-aid provision, personal protective equipment, confined-space entry procedures, and workers' compensation insurance coverage.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Department of Finance and Treasury, Value Added Tax (VAT) Unit; online portal: https://vata.gov.vu (VAT electronic filing portal); company registry administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) via https://www.vfsc.vu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity forming an International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act (Cap. 222) must engage a licensed registered agent in Vanuatu. The agent files the incorporation application with the VFSC, obtains the Certificate of Incorporation, and then applies for a VAT identification number with the Vanuatu VAT Unit if taxable supplies are made or if the entity elects voluntary registration. For non-resident ICs with no local VAT-taxable activities, no VAT registration is mandatory, but the IC must maintain a registered office and agent in Vanuatu. The statutory TIN for tax administration purposes is the VFSC company registration number; a separate VAT ID is issued by the VAT Unit upon registration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: An International Company is by default exempt from Vanuatu income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, and stamp duty on international transactions; however, it may elect to register for VAT under the Value Added Tax Act No. 3 of 1998 if it wishes to claim input VAT credits or engage in local taxable supplies. No check-the-box pass-through election exists under Vanuatu law, as the IC is a separate legal entity; hybrid mismatch elections are not recognized because Vanuatu generally imposes no direct corporate income tax.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: A person making taxable supplies in Vanuatu of more than VT 5,000,000 (five million Vatu) in any 12-month period is required to register for VAT; registration is voluntary below the threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance mandate is currently implemented in Vanuatu. VAT-registered persons must issue a standard tax invoice within 28 days of a taxable supply, retain records for at least 10 years, and file VAT returns electronically through the Vanuatu VAT online portal by the last day of the month following the end of the tax period. API-based real-time clearance and digital stamping are not yet statutory requirements.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero rating is available under Section 11 of the Value Added Tax Act No. 3 of 1998 for the export of goods supplied to a non-resident, provided the goods are exported within 90 days of the supply, and for the supply of certain internationally rendered services (including ship construction, repair, and maintenance for non-resident clients) where the recipient is outside Vanuatu and the benefit of the service occurs outside Vanuatu. The shipyard must hold valid VAT registration and submit documentary evidence proving physical export from Vanuatu.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Vanuatu Customs Form C4)
Bill of Lading or Certificate of Shipment for ocean-going vessel delivery
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank transfer evidence confirming receipt of payment from the non-resident buyer
Original tax invoice marked as zero-rated export
Copy of the executed commercial contract and delivery acceptance certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The VAT Commissioner may audit any zero-rated export claim and require proof of export and foreign exchange repatriation. If the exporter fails to substantiate zero-rating or the foreign currency proceeds are not repatriated within 180 days without approved exception, the zero rate is reversed and output VAT is assessed at 12.5%, with interest at 12% per annum. Fraudulent zero-rating claims attract a penalty of up to 200% of the tax evaded, imprisonment of up to 5 years, cancellation of VAT registration, and retrospective clawback of any input VAT credits claimed. Under Vanuatu's mutual administrative assistance commitments, failure to substantiate exports also constitutes tax evasion and may trigger exchange of information with the recipient jurisdiction.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), established under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap 125], acting as the monetary authority, bank supervisor, and administrator of exchange-control policy under the Exchange Control Act [Cap 90]. The Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) is the corporate registrar and licensing authority for International Companies (ICs). For a VU_IC, the International Companies Act [Cap 222] expressly disapplies exchange-control restrictions on transactions with non-residents, subject to the IC's statutory prohibition on carrying on domestic business with Vanuatu residents without VFSC consent.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vatu (VUV) is broadly convertible on both current and capital account. Capital-account liberalization means no prior RBV approval is required for non-resident equity injections, dividend distributions, interest remittances, loan repayments, or liquidation proceeds of an IC. Practical hurdles are not statutory but institutional: (i) licensed commercial banks maintain strict internal USD-liquidity and correspondent-bank quotas; (ii) global correspondent banks apply enhanced due diligence on Vanuatu-flagged entities because of historic FATF grey-listing (2015-2018) and periodic EU tax-listing scrutiny; (iii) large USD flows must be channelled through the offshore nostro accounts of the clearing bank to avoid VUV liquidity constraints. Shipbuilding-related payments may lawfully be denominated and settled wholly in USD or EUR outside the VUV system.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu imposes no statutory surrender of export proceeds. There is no mandatory conversion timeline, no minimum conversion ratio, and no requirement that shipbuilding milestone receipts be repatriated into VUV. Exporters and ICs may retain foreign currency indefinitely in foreign-currency accounts at an authorized dealer. For the VU_IC engaged in commercial vessel construction, all USD/EUR export proceeds under maritime installment contracts may be held offshore or in onshore nostro-linked foreign-currency accounts without RBV approval, provided the underlying transactions are documented and the IC maintains its offshore-status compliance.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational USD Current Account / Trade Finance LC Facility
Capital Escrow Account / Operational USD and VUV Accounts / Maritime Installment LC Facility
Operational Account / Foreign-Currency Account / Escrow Sub-Account
Operational USD Account / Standby LC Facility
Retail/Development Bank; not suited for offshore IC Escrow or LC-heavy structures

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: Low as a primary clearing rail; Medium only as a supplementary disbursement conduit. Vanuatu has no domestic EMI licensing category; offshore-authorized digital EMIs (e.g., UK FCA, MAS-Singapore, or Lithuania ECB-licensed) may service the IC for operational payments but cannot settle in VUV, cannot issue VUV-denominated instruments, and are frequently refused correspondent clearing for Vanuatu-registered ICs. Correspondent policy requires full beneficial-ownership disclosure and sanctions pre-screening before any EMI transaction is executed. Therefore the statutory maritime installment LC and escrow rails must be hosted at an RBV-licensed authorized dealer; EMIs should be restricted to petty operational spend.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Vanuatu law does not mandate physical director attendance; however, all RBV-licensed banks apply internal AML/CFT policies (AML/CFT Act No. 7 of 2019 and RBV prudential guidelines) that generally require at least one director, ultimate beneficial owner, or authorized signatory to undergo an in-person or bank-supervised video KYC interview at the Port Vila branch before account activation. Remote onboarding is accepted only for non-signatory shareholders; every signatory must deliver a notarized and apostilled KYC pack, with the wet-ink original couriered to the bank. ANZ and BSP accept video-KYC with couriered originals; NBV insists on physical appearance of all signatories. A licensed Vanuatu registered agent (law firm or corporate services provider) is a practical prerequisite to expedite clearance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Shell-company indicators: a newly incorporated IC with no audited accounts, minimal physical footprint, and no trade history applying for a high-value maritime escrow and installment LC facility.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC Certificate of Incorporation; VFSC Certificate of Good Standing; Certificate of Incumbency naming directors, shareholders, and licensed registered agent; notarized and apostilled passports of all beneficial owners; licensed-agent reference letter; audited or reviewed financial projections for the container-vessel construction program; executed shipbuilding contract, letter of intent, or binding order book; corporate organizational chart; VFSC beneficial-ownership registration receipt.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-ownership ambiguity arising from nominee directors, trusts, or legacy bearer instruments (bearer shares require VFSC authorization and custodial immobilization under the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2005).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Written confirmation that no bearer shares are outstanding or, if issued, that they are immobilized with a VFSC-approved custodian; full BO-register filing receipt from VFSC; nominee and trust declarations with underlying settlement deeds; sworn beneficial-ownership declaration with passport copies; independent verification by the licensed agent.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-disbursement red flags: third-party payees, payments to high-risk jurisdictions for shipbuilding inputs (steel plate, marine engines, navigation systems), or invoice over/under-invoicing in milestone claims.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: OFAC/EU/UN consolidated sanctions-screening reports for each counterparty; corporate registration extracts of all suppliers; cascading back-to-back purchase orders and sub-contracts; independently certified stage-completion certificates from a class surveyor (e.g., Bureau Veritas or DNV) or independent marine engineer; original commercial invoices, packing lists, and delivery receipts; UCP 600-compliant LC terms disclosing ports of loading and final vessel flag; escrow agent's KYC and transaction-monitoring sign-off.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid inbound capital injection disproportionate to declared share capital or suspicion of layering, given that an IC has no minimum capital requirement.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Shareholder resolution and share-subscription agreement evidencing issue price and share count; source of funds and source of wealth statements with supporting bank statements and tax records; explicit designation of injected amounts as equity or shareholder loans; project-level cash-flow budget tied to shipbuilding milestones; certified corporate bank statements of the remitting entity; board confirmation that no Vanuatu resident holds a direct or indirect interest.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: USD/EUR-denominated transaction flows inconsistent with the VUV pegged-currency regime, raising potential FX-speculation or round-tripping concern.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Underlying shipbuilding contracts denominated in USD/EUR; board-approved FX-hedging policy limited to genuine commercial exposures; accountant's attestation that no speculative FX positions are maintained; annual board resolution confirming hedging intent; deal-level break-even analysis showing the natural currency matching of payables and receivables.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route all equity injections via SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's account to the IC's segregated Capital Escrow Account at an RBV-licensed authorized dealer (ANZ or BSP preferred), using the SWIFT narrative 'SHARE CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION — VFSC REGISTRATION No. [VU_IC]'. The receiving bank will require the board resolution authorizing the share issue, the share-subscription agreement, and the VFSC BO-registration confirmation. For amounts above USD 1,000,000, provide advance notice and a completed source-of-funds declaration. The escrow agent holds irrevocable release instructions conditioned upon (i) shipyard contract milestones, (ii) class-surveyor interim certificates, and (iii) LC drawdown confirmations. If any Vanuatu resident holds an interest, a Foreign Investment Board declaration and RBV statistical notification may be triggered; for a pure offshore IC with 100% non-resident ownership, no RBV approval is required.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails for construction disbursements: (1) Maritime Installment LC issued via SWIFT MT700 under UCP 600, with confirmation from the issuing bank's parent (ANZ Australia or BSP Papua New Guinea) to overcome Vanuatu's country-limit constraints; (2) standby LC via MT760 as advance-payment or performance security for subcontractors; (3) direct SWIFT MT103 for pre-shipment payments of steel, engines, and outfitting equipment against original invoices and sanctions-screening reports; (4) MT202 or MT202 COV for bank-to-bank cover and cross-currency conversion; (5) escrow releases strictly against independent marine-surveyor stage certificates. All multi-currency payments must conform to the IC's annual return filings and the authorized dealer's statistical reporting obligations; no RBV exchange-control approval is required for non-resident counterparties.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore FX spot contracts with RBV-licensed authorized dealers in USD/VUV, AUD/VUV, and EUR/VUV
Outright deliverable FX forwards (vanilla, up to 12 months) hedging documented shipbuilding payables and receivables
FX swaps matching installment LC funding currencies against expected milestone receipts
Cross-currency swaps with offshore investment-bank counterparties, subject to the IC's documented hedging policy and OFAC/UN sanctions screening
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on VUV/USD executed through international banks in Singapore or Hong Kong, permitted only for genuine commercial exposure and not for speculative positions

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (International Company) with prescribed annual fee — standard band: authorised capital up to VUV 1,000,000
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Port Vila
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due within 6 months of each incorporation anniversary (financial period ends on the anniversary of incorporation; first filing arises at the first anniversary)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: VFSC late-filing penalty of approx. VUV 12,500 (US$110) per month per form; statutory offence under International Companies Act (Cap. 222) with fine up to VUV 100,000 for the company and each defaulting officer; unpaid fees for 3–6 months expose the company to Gazette-noticed strike-off, and on dissolution all assets vest in the Government of Vanuatu.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of directors, members and beneficial owners (register audit and UBO refresh)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent (statutory records at the registered office) and Registrar upon inspection
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually in conjunction with the Annual Return; every share transfer or director/UBO change must be recorded in the statutory registers and notified to the registered agent within the agent's standing update cycle (standard 5 business days)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Incomplete or false register particulars constitute an offence under Cap. 222 (fine up to VUV 100,000); persistent non-disclosure enables the registered agent to resign, triggering automatic commencement of strike-off proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Economic substance confirmation — not applicable (ISIC 3011 commercial shipbuilding is manufacturing, not a designated 'relevant activity' under the Vanuatu economic substance regime)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: No filing — assessment only if the entity commences a relevant activity (e.g., shipping, distribution centre, financing or leasing) subject to the Companies and Limited Partnerships (Economic Substance) Act 2019
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No deadline while the shipyard performs only manufacturing; re-assessment required if a relevant activity is initiated during any financial period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Not applicable to current scope; penalties under the 2019 Economic Substance Act (including monetary penalties and deregistration) would apply only upon commencement of a covered activity without filing.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None. International Companies under Cap. 222 are exempt from statutory audit irrespective of size or turnover; an independent audit is required only if the company also holds a regulated VFSC licence (banking, insurance, securities) or if members voluntarily resolve to appoint auditors.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS or equivalent standards are permissible on a voluntary basis; the mandatory base standard under Cap. 222, s.50 is the maintenance of accounting records that correctly explain transactions and fairly reflect the financial position. Financial statements need not be filed with the VFSC.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The VFSC-licensed registered agent is the statutory anchor. Beneficial ownership particulars are captured at incorporation, confirmed annually in writing with the Annual Return, and re-confirmed on every share transfer before the register of members is amended (AML/CFT amendments to Cap. 222). Any bearer shares must be physically held by a VFSC-approved custodian and remain traceable in the statutory registers.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 450 – USD 900 per annum (VFSC-licensed registered agent and registered office, Port Vila)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not statutorily required; if voluntarily commissioned, approximately USD 5,000 – USD 12,000 per engagement

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% - Vanuatu levies no general corporate income tax; International Companies are expressly exempt from all taxes on income, profits, dividends, capital gains, and interest pursuant to Section 47 of the International Companies Act 1992.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0% effective rate for a VU International Company; no corporate tax, no dividend withholding tax, no payroll tax, and no capital gains tax. The only recurring fiscal costs are the VFSC annual license fee and the 12.5% Value Added Tax on local taxable supplies of goods and services; profits derived from non-resident sources, including shipbuilding proceeds from ocean container vessel construction, are tax-exempt.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Annual Renewal and Annual Return (International Company) - lodged by the Vanuatu-registered agent through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) online e-portal / licensed agent portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual license fee and Annual Return are due on or before 31 December of each calendar year, calculated pro-rata for the registration year; late payment beyond the statutory grace period attracts automatic penalties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 - Company Name and Registration Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name of the International Company and unique VFSC registration number as stated on the Certificate of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter exact registered name; no trading names unless separately notified to the registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 - Registered Office and Registered Agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical address in Vanuatu and identity of the licensed registered agent maintaining corporate records.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be a real physical address; P.O. boxes alone are rejected. The agent must be a VFSC-licensed service provider.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, nationality, residential addresses, and passport/ID details of each director, secretary, and authorized officer.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted; nominee directors must be disclosed to the agent but are not publicly searchable under IC confidentiality rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered shareholders, beneficial owners, share classes, issued share capital, and consideration paid.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ownership is 100% permitted; bearer shares are prohibited; beneficial ownership register must be filed with the agent for AML compliance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Description of the commercial activity, including ISIC classification (ISIC 3011 - Building of ships and floating structures).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State 'Commercial shipbuilding of ocean container vessels (ISIC 3011)'; must match the AML business profile and any escrow/LC payment rail documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 - Compliance Declaration and Economic Substance Statement
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of solvency, compliance with the International Companies Act, and confirmation of whether the company is carrying on a relevant activity for economic substance purposes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shipyards must accurately declare no local taxable activity and no designated ESR relevant activity unless vessel chartering/operation generates Vanuatu-source income.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing or late payment of the VFSC annual fee incurs a statutory penalty of 20% of the annual fee. Continued default beyond 3 months results in automatic administrative strike-off, loss of separate legal personality, and significant reinstatement fees. A struck-off International Company cannot execute contracts, operate escrow accounts, or present Letters of Credit.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Vanuatu VAT Return (VAT Act 1998) - electronically filed through the Vanuatu Department of Finance and Treasury VAT filing system.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Monthly (taxable period is the calendar month; annual balancing returns are not available for regular traders).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The VAT Return and payment must be lodged within 30 days after the end of each calendar month; non-resident shipyard entities making local taxable supplies in Vanuatu must register if turnover exceeds the VAT registration threshold.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 12.5% VAT collected on local taxable supplies of shipbuilding services, vessel components, and yard services supplied within Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ICs exporting ocean vessels entirely outside Vanuatu are not subject to VAT on export sales; export of goods is zero-rated. Local shipyard services rendered to third parties in Vanuatu attract output tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Creditable VAT paid on business inputs, machinery, raw materials, and subcontractor services acquired in Vanuatu for the shipyard.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Input credits are available only where the non-resident entity is VAT-registered in Vanuatu and holds valid tax invoices; input tax on exempt or non-business expenditure is not creditable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 13 - Net VAT Payable or Refundable
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Excess of output tax over input tax payable to the Vanuatu government, or excess input tax claimed as a refund.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: VAT-exempt International Companies engaged solely in non-resident shipbuilding typically have no net VAT payable; claims for refund require full documentation and customs evidence of export.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file a VAT Return attracts a penalty of 25% of the tax amount due, plus a monthly late penalty of 5% for each month or part-month of continued default (capped at 100% aggregate on the unpaid tax). Directors may be personally assessed for knowing failure to account for VAT under the VAT Act 1998.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Vanuatu does not impose any withholding tax on dividends paid by an International Company to resident or non-resident shareholders. Dividend distributions from the shipyard's tax-exempt profits are free from domestic WHT.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement (DTA) network and provides no domestic WHT that would require relief. A non-resident shareholder does not need TRC or treaty approval in Vanuatu because there is no withholding tax at source. Where a foreign tax authority requires proof of Vanuatu residence or tax exemption, the International Company may apply through its registered agent to the Vanuatu Department of Finance and Treasury / VFSC for a Certificate of Tax Residence or Tax Exemption Certificate; the application requires certified corporate documents, audited or signed accounts, declaration of no local taxable activity, and payment of the applicable VFSC administrative fee. Such certificates merely evidence facts; they do not create treaty rights.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory and effective rate - Vanuatu levies no withholding tax on interest or IP royalties paid by an International Company to non-residents. Debt finance from foreign shipbuilding financiers, escrow interest, and charter/royalty payments to foreign licensors are repatriable gross without WHT.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable - Vanuatu has no statutory transfer pricing documentation regime and no Vatu-denominated Local File or Master File threshold. No arm's length documentation is required for the tax-exempt International Company (which is outside the CIT net). Nonetheless, under the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019, any entity engaged in a 'relevant activity' must maintain contemporaneous economic substance records in Vanuatu; prudent shipyard entities should maintain benchmarked contracts for intra-group charter, IP, and financing transactions to protect foreign tax positions.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019 (as amended) applies to tax-exempt ICs earning income from relevant activities, including Shipping, Financing and Leasing, Headquarters, Holding Company, IP Business, Distribution and Service Centre. Commercial shipbuilding of ocean container vessels under ISIC 3011 is a manufacturing activity and is not a statutorily designated relevant activity per se; however, if the VU_IC also earns income from vessel ownership, chartering, or ship management (beyond pure construction), the Shipping relevant activity is triggered. Triggered entities must demonstrate in Vanuatu: (i) local management control in the jurisdiction, (ii) commensurate physical premises and employees, and (iii) core income-generating activities conducted in Vanuatu. Failure to meet the economic substance test exposes the entity to exchange of information with foreign tax authorities, financial penalties of up to VT 10,000,000 for severe non-compliance, and risk of strike-off.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Fraudulent Abuse of Tax-Exempt Status
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Vanuatu International Company to evade foreign corporate taxes, misrepresenting the vessel-sale contract as Vanuatu-source income without real local substance, engaging in artificial non-resident booking of shipbuilding profits, or deliberately understating VAT on local supplies.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Financial penalties equal to the omitted tax plus a penalty of up to 200% of the tax evaded under the Vanuatu VAT Act 1998 for VAT fraud; cancellation of the International Company's exempt status by VFSC; disqualification of the registered agent; monetary penalties of up to VT 10,000,000 under the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act for false substance declarations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors sign annual compliance declarations; knowing false declarations constitute an offense under the International Companies Act 1992 and the Economic Substance Act, carrying fines and imprisonment of up to 12 months. In flagrant schemes, courts may pierce the corporate veil and order directors to personally restore diverted shipyard funds or pay civil restitution to defrauded foreign revenue authorities.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operation of a 'letterbox' shipyard International Company with no physical office, no local employees, no board meetings in Vanuatu, and no real bookkeeping, while deriving commercial vessel-sale income and claiming exemption before foreign customs or revenue agencies; or conducting a Shipping relevant activity without Vanuatu substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative penalties under the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019 including financial penalties up to VT 10,000,000 and mandatory exchange of information with foreign competent authorities; VFSC may strike off the company for failure to file Annual Returns; the entity loses legal capacity and escrow/LC operations are frozen.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Under the Economic Substance Act, officers who knowingly cause or permit the company to fail the substance test are personally liable for penalties; fines of up to VT 750,000 per officer; a court may impose a travel ban and disqualification from acting as director of any VFSC-licensed entity in Vanuatu.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Anti-Money Laundering / AML and CFT Violations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Handling maritime installment Letters of Credit, escrow payments, or third-party payments for ocean container vessel construction without appointing an AML compliance officer, conducting customer due diligence (CDD) on beneficial owners of shipowner-customers, investigating politically exposed persons (PEPs), maintaining transaction records, or reporting suspicious transactions; routing vessel escrow funds through unlicensed shell accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Sanctions under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2014: monetary penalties up to VT 50,000,000 for corporate entities for serious AML failures; suspension or revocation of the International Company's registration and the agent's license; forfeiture of vessel-related funds held in escrow; inclusion of the entity on the Vanuatu AML high-risk advisory list, obstructing future LC and bank correspondent arrangements.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and AML officers face imprisonment of up to 25 years for money laundering offenses, up to 15 years for financing terrorism, and daily penalties for failure to file suspicious transaction reports; directors who knowingly sign false beneficial ownership declarations may face criminal conviction, restitution orders, and travel restrictions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Civil Fraud / Misuse of Corporate Form (Piercing the Corporate Veil)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Intermingling of shipyard contract proceeds with directors' personal accounts, abandonment of corporate formalities, issuance of false invoices to escrow agents, under-capitalization of the International Company with fraudulent diversion of construction progress payments, or repudiation of legitimate creditor claims after transferring assets abroad.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu courts may pierce the veil under common law principles, rendering the International Company's separate legal personality ineffective for the fraudulent transaction; directors and shareholders may be jointly liable for all unpaid debts of the shipyard, including refunds due under LCs and escrow agreements, plus interest and legal costs; the VFSC may order forensic audit and liquidation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Civil restitution for the entire loss suffered by shipowner-customers and financiers; punitive damages in cases of deliberate deceit; disqualification orders under the International Companies Act barring management of any Vanuatu entity for up to 10 years; judicial travel bans and asset-freezing orders pending satisfaction of the judgment.
